passages.label: Juv. 13.237
passages.text: cum scelus admittunt, superest constantia; quod fas

passages.label: Juv. 13.238
passages.text: atque nefas, tandem incipiunt sentire peractis

passages.label: Juv. 13.239
passages.text: criminibus, tamen ad mores natura recurrit

passages.label: Juv. 13.240
passages.text: damnatos fixa et mutari nescia, nam quis

passages.label: Juv. 13.241
passages.text: peccandi finem posuit sibi? quando recepit

passages.label: Juv. 13.242
passages.text: eiectum semel attrita de fronte ruborem?

passages.label: Juv. 13.243
passages.text: quisnam hominum est quem tu contentum videris uno

passages.label: Juv. 13.244
passages.text: flagitio? dabit in laqueum vestigia noster

passages.label: Juv. 13.245
passages.text: perfidus et nigri patietur carceris uncum

passages.label: Juv. 13.246
passages.text: aut maris Aegaei rupem scopulosque frequentes

passages.label: Juv. 13.247
passages.text: exulibus magnis, poena gaudebis amara

passages.label: Juv. 13.248
passages.text: nominis invisi, tandemque fatebere laetus

passages.label: Juv. 13.249
passages.text: nec surdum nec Teresian quemquam esse deorum.
